name: Tourenschein
export_instructions: In SilverERP Disposition Aufträge öffnen und die angezeigte Liste als CSV exportieren.
query:
SELECT ANY_VALUE('[' || `Kunden-Nr.` || '] ' || `Name 1` || chr(10) || `Ort`) AS Name, ANY_VALUE(`Beleg-Nr.` || ' (' || `W.-Termin` || ')' || chr(10) || `B.-Brutto` || ' €') AS Vorgang,
		(CASE INSTR(',' || GROUP_CONCAT(`Artikel-Nr.`), ',10') WHEN 0 THEN '' ELSE 'X TIEFKÜHL' END) || chr(10) 
			|| (CASE INSTR(',' || GROUP_CONCAT(`Artikel-Nr.`), ',20') WHEN 0 THEN '' ELSE 'O FLEISCH' END) AS Wareninfo
        FROM data GROUP BY `Beleg-Nr.` ORDER BY MIN(`Kunden-Nr.`) ASC, `Beleg-Nr.` ASC

variables.name: tour
variables.label: tour
variables.query:
SELECT REPLACE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT `Tour`), ',', ', ') FROM 
				(SELECT CASE `Tour` WHEN '' THEN 'NZ' ELSE `Tour` END AS 'Tour' FROM data ORDER BY `Tour` ASC) x
